name: OpenTelemetry trace with DTaaS provenance attributes
abstract: OTLP JSON trace shape used to record OGC API Processes provenance.

examples.title: Localoutlier OpenTelemetry trace
examples.content: An OTLP JSON trace carrying the DTaaS processing activity, subject, and object attributes.

annotatedSchema:
type: object
required:
- resourceSpans
properties:
  resourceSpans:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      required:
      - resource
      - scopeSpans
      properties:
        resource:
          type: object
          properties:
            attributes:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/$defs/attribute'
        scopeSpans:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - spans
            properties:
              scope:
                type: object
              spans:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  required:
                  - traceId
                  - spanId
                  - name
                  - startTimeUnixNano
                  - endTimeUnixNano
                  properties:
                    traceId:
                      type: string
                    spanId:
                      type: string
                    parentSpanId:
                      type: string
                    name:
                      type: string
                    kind:
                      type: integer
                    startTimeUnixNano:
                      type: string
                    endTimeUnixNano:
                      type: string
                    attributes:
                      type: array
                      items:
                        $ref: '#/$defs/attribute'
                    status:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        code:
                          type: integer
$defs:
  attribute:
    type: object
    required:
    - key
    - value
    properties:
      key:
        type: string
      value:
        type: object
        properties:
          stringValue:
            type: string
          intValue:
            type: string
          boolValue:
            type: boolean
